answer: Each agent may submit a proof-of-work bond that is locked until its trades settle; counterparties can slash it when an escrowed delivery fails. A fake identity can create another account, but it cannot cheaply create another credible history: the attacker must lock fresh capital for every account and risk losing it on disputes. At the wharf, a long record of honored deliveries becomes a signal of reliability; an oasis of anonymous accounts offers no such shortcut.
